title: Product
description: A product or service offering of Rough Draft Builders Club (RDBC) that this marketing-operations project may research, describe, and market. This is a schema *contract* only (architecture/DATA_CONTRACTS.md §8) — no runtime enforces it yet (src/ does not exist before Phase 16). Pricing is one of the nine human-approval-gated categories (CLAUDE.md §4, README.md "Primary success criteria", policy/action_registry.json GC-02): this schema deliberately carries no raw price/amount/currency field, because instantiating one without a governing decision on its shape would invite a value to be set with no approval binding. Instead, `pricing_approval_id` links the record to whatever approval authorized its current pricing/offer terms, leaving the price value itself outside this schema's scope until a later phase defines it against an actual approval-queue implementation (Phase 15, per MASTER_PLAN.md). See architecture/STATE_MACHINE.md for this entity's documented lifecycle transitions between `status` values.

id.description: Server-assigned identity. Never client-supplied, never reused. Shared envelope field, architecture/DATA_CONTRACTS.md §2.1.

schema_version.description: The exact semver version of product.schema.json this record was written against. architecture/DATA_CONTRACTS.md §2.1, §3.

idempotency_key.description: Caller-chosen deduplication key; a create request whose idempotency_key matches an existing product record returns the existing record rather than creating a duplicate. architecture/DATA_CONTRACTS.md §2.1, §4.

status.description: This product's own production/lifecycle status — distinct from any approval workflow status. Enum values and reasoning are this schema's own design choice (Data Architect, Phase 04); the transitions between them are documented separately in architecture/STATE_MACHINE.md, which cites this exact enum. DRAFT: the product is being defined internally and is not yet offered to any external audience. ACTIVE: the product is currently offered. DEPRECATED: the product is being phased out — still referenced by existing records or commitments but no longer promoted as a current offering. RETIRED: the product is no longer offered or supported in any capacity.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339. Set once, never mutated. architecture/DATA_CONTRACTS.md §2.1.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339. Set on every accepted mutation; must be >= created_at. architecture/DATA_CONTRACTS.md §2.1.

created_by_role.description: Which role created this record — a closed role token from policy/action_registry.json's `roles` array, never a person's name or an invented role. architecture/DATA_CONTRACTS.md §2.1.

name.description: The product's structural name/label. This schema places no format or content constraint on it beyond non-emptiness — no example value here resembles a real RDBC product name (architecture/DATA_CONTRACTS.md §1's data-minimisation rule, extended project-wide).

description.description: A structural description of what this product is. Any external-facing claim this text implies is itself GC-01 ("claims") gated content — storing the description here is not the same as it being approved for external use (PUBLISHING_POLICY.md governs that separately).

pricing_approval_id.description: References the approval record (see APPROVAL_POLICY.md, and schemas/approval.schema.json) that authorized this product's current pricing/offer terms. Null until a pricing approval has been requested or granted — pricing is GC-02, one of the nine categories requiring human approval before any external-facing statement of price (CLAUDE.md §4). This field does not itself carry a price value; see this schema's top-level description for why.
